Q: Can't see Git > Blame (Annotate) in Visual Studio 2022 (17.11.2)? A:

Git blame is available when you right click on the file in the solution explorer view. That will reopen the file with the blame annotations on the left side.

Q: Producing a PNG with MiniZ A:

Taking a look at your png output, the first thing I run into is that you are writing the IDAT chunk length in the wrong byte order. Integers in PNG are written with the most significant byte first. You have 0c 00 00 00 where you should have written 00 00 00 0c (assuming that 12 is the correct length).

Q: What app or software can take distance and bearing inputs from a GPS coordinate and map an area, preferably over google maps A:

Try a web-based apps like SurveyPlotter. It lets you input a starting GPS coordinate, then enter each bearing and distance to generate a boundary polygon that can be exported to Google Maps

Q: Python Selenium with Firefox getting a button click doesn't seem to work A:

I see what I think are two separate issues:

  1. I think one of the problems is that you have disabled Javascript,

    firefox_profile.set_preference("javascript.enabled", False)

    but one of the elements you are clicking has an onclick which is Javascript. The HTML is below,

    <button id="flossy" onclick="getElementById('demo').innerHTML = Date()">Help</button>
                    ^^^^        this part here is Javascript        ^^^

    Remove the line that disables Javascript and that should fix it.

  2. I see a couple deprecation warnings in the error message,

    <path to file>/test.py:40: DeprecationWarning: firefox_profile has been deprecated, please use an Options object
  firefox_profile = FirefoxProfile()
<path to file>/test.py:42: DeprecationWarning: Setting a profile has been deprecated. Please use the set_preference and install_addons methods
  options.profile = firefox_profile

    This means that those methods/properties you are using have been removed and are no longer valid. In your case, it isn't that big of a deal because you no longer want to disable Javascript so the need for the FirefoxProfile() is gone.

    So this code

    url = "file:///<path to html file>/test.html"

options = Options()
firefox_profile = FirefoxProfile()
firefox_profile.set_preference("javascript.enabled", False)
options.profile = firefox_profile

driver = webdriver.Firefox(options=options)

    becomes

    url = "file:///<path to html file>/test.html"

driver = webdriver.Firefox(options=options)

after all the options bits are removed.

Try those two things and let us know if that works.

Q: Java NIO: Ideal approach to high-speed sequentially streaming large binary data to a file A:

First establish that you have a problem. You don't. A couple of bytes per tenth of a second is nothing. Start with a BufferedOutputStream wrapped around a FileOutputStream. Nothing more is needed at the speed you cite.

Q: How to convert a guide tutorial into context readible and feasible for AI? A:

To convert a guide or tutorial into a format that’s readable and feasible for an AI agent, the key lies in breaking down the content into digestible, structured data that the AI can process effectively. Simply feeding a whole PDF won't allow the agent to understand the nuances and context of the material. Instead, consider extracting the core concepts, patterns, and code snippets, then segment them into smaller, logical chunks. For example, convert essential concepts into structured data like key-value pairs or JSON, which can be parsed and understood by your AI. Additionally, providing context around each snippet—such as the problem it solves and its use case—helps the AI to better grasp the purpose behind the patterns. You may also want to create an index of terms or commands that the AI can refer to, enabling it to easily search and apply knowledge in real-time. Finally, for a practical implementation, you can integrate this structured data with your VSCode AI agent through APIs that support these formats, allowing the agent to query, learn, and implement relevant patterns effectively.
